finding_or_review_point: AI-assisted document-only HITL review; not a deployed workload assessment or exhaustive AWS Well-Architected assessment.
risk: Implementation and runtime behavior have not been verified.
recommended_fix: Recommended verdict is REVISE; retain blank scores until a human evaluates evidence. Architecture file is unchanged.
acceptance_evidence: Human completes five scores; PASS requires at least 12/15 and every dimension at least 2; attach logging checker result.

finding_or_review_point: PENDING publication recovery depends entirely on source-message retries.
risk: If SNS remains unavailable until maxReceiveCount or source retention is exhausted then a durable decision can remain unpublished indefinitely; the claim that settlement cannot miss a decision is too strong.
recommended_fix: Define a durable outbox recovery mechanism using a scheduled reconciler or DynamoDB Streams with explicit retention-gap reconciliation; track publication age and retain reviewed redrive as a recovery path. Account for any added Lambda in the course limit.
acceptance_evidence: Keep SNS unavailable beyond three receives; restore it and prove the stored decision is eventually delivered without a new producer event and without duplicate settlement effects.

finding_or_review_point: Strict per-pnr ordering ends at the standard SNS topic and standard settlement queue.
risk: Settlement can receive distinct decisions out of order even when the ingress FIFO handler is correct.
recommended_fix: Confirm the required ordering boundary. If settlement requires ordering use SNS FIFO plus SQS FIFO with consistent MessageGroupId and deduplication identity; otherwise explicitly limit the FIFO guarantee to decision processing and require version-aware settlement.
acceptance_evidence: Deliver two decisions for the same pnr with delayed and duplicate deliveries; prove the approved settlement ordering/version policy.

finding_or_review_point: Moving a failed message to the FIFO DLQ unblocks later messages in its group.
risk: Later decisions can run before the failed event; manual redrive cannot restore the original sequence automatically.
recommended_fix: Approve either a per-pnr quarantine/hold policy with reconciliation or an explicit relaxation of strict business sequencing. Define how later decisions are reconciled before redrive; do not claim a FIFO DLQ preserves the original business sequence.
acceptance_evidence: Fail the first of three same-pnr events through redrive and verify later events are held or safely reconciled according to the approved policy.

finding_or_review_point: Readable identifiers on invalid input lead to MANUAL_REVIEW followed by deletion with no explicit publish step.
risk: A manual-review decision may be stored but never reach settlement or a reviewer; missing required fields may also prevent record construction.
recommended_fix: Define a minimal validated quarantine/review schema and route it through the same durable PENDING-to-publication workflow before acknowledgement. Treat persistence/publication failures as retryable and make repeated invalid events idempotent.
acceptance_evidence: Inject invalid fare_amount and missing ticket_number with valid identifiers; prove one durable review case and eventual notification despite a crash before publish.

finding_or_review_point: The sort key is event_id rather than time; latest-record selection and Query pagination are unspecified.
risk: Lexicographic event_id order is not chronological; reading only the first 1 MB can miss an earlier refund and allow an incorrect decision.
recommended_fix: Specify complete paginated evaluation with normalized UTC timestamps as a minimal fix; preferably maintain a bounded per-ticket refund summary and per-pnr sequence/version using conditional atomic updates. Check the existing event identity before re-evaluating history on retries.
acceptance_evidence: Use event IDs whose lexical order differs from timestamps and history exceeding 1 MB; prove both guards still work and duplicate replay uses the original stored decision.

finding_or_review_point: Identity scope differs across DynamoDB idempotency and downstream deduplication.
risk: The table uses pnr plus event_id while ingress deduplication and settlement use event_id alone; collisions can suppress unrelated events unless global uniqueness is guaranteed. Reused PNRs also require a retention/identity policy.
recommended_fix: Declare and enforce globally unique event_id values or use one airline-scoped booking/event identity consistently across producer deduplication, decision keys and settlement. Define PNR reuse handling and reject same-key different-payload replays using a canonical fingerprint.
acceptance_evidence: Test identical event_id values across different bookings and replay one identity with changed cancellation data; verify no silent suppression or mutation.

finding_or_review_point: Settlement deduplication is a requirement but its atomic relationship to the refund side effect is unspecified.
risk: Marking an event processed before refund execution can lose a refund; marking it afterward can double-refund after a crash.
recommended_fix: Name the settlement owner and define atomic ledger/deduplication updates or an idempotency key supported by the external refund system. Specify a strongly consistent decision lookup for IDs-only notifications and include immutable decision identity/version.
acceptance_evidence: Crash settlement immediately before and after its refund side effect; replay duplicates and prove exactly one financial effect.

finding_or_review_point: Append-only and never overwritten conflict with publication status updates.
risk: Audit immutability and permitted writes are ambiguous; an unconditional update could recreate a deleted record or modify a terminal state.
recommended_fix: Describe immutable decision attributes separately from mutable delivery metadata; use an existence/status-conditioned update and preserve the original decision on retry. Separate append-only audit events if strict immutability is required.
acceptance_evidence: Review conditional expressions and test missing-record updates, duplicate updates and attempts to mutate decision attributes.

finding_or_review_point: Added refund guards and the fixed two-decimal currency policy need business approval.
risk: Legitimate partial-then-full cancellations are always escalated after an approved refund; an out-of-order timestamp for another ticket in the same pnr can cause unnecessary review. Unsupported currency exponents can produce wrong refunds.
recommended_fix: Approve guard scope, partial-refund accounting and manual-review outcomes; validate finite Decimal values, currency support, timestamp timezone, flags and required fields. Implement currency-specific quantization or quarantine unsupported currencies before calculating a refund.
acceptance_evidence: Signed business examples for partial/full refunds, multiple tickets per pnr, equal/older timestamps, NaN/Infinity, JPY and a three-decimal currency.

finding_or_review_point: H5 mentions an SNS delivery DLQ but the resource list defines only the ingress FIFO DLQ.
risk: SNS acceptance does not mean subscriber delivery; a missing subscription DLQ can lose notifications after delivery failure. A standard subscription cannot reuse the ingress FIFO DLQ.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit SNS subscription RedrivePolicy and compatible dedicated DLQ, queue policy, encryption permissions, depth alarm and replay procedure. Also define settlement-consumer processing DLQ ownership and recovery.
acceptance_evidence: Deny SNS access to the settlement queue; prove failed delivery reaches the subscription DLQ and can be replayed. Poison a settlement event and verify its consumer DLQ.

finding_or_review_point: Duplicate handling reads a decision but dynamodb:GetItem is absent from the Lambda action list.
risk: A point read used to resume PENDING or skip PUBLISHED decisions fails with AccessDenied.
recommended_fix: Choose the exact read API; add ARN-scoped dynamodb:GetItem if using a point read or explicitly implement an exact-key Query using the existing permission. Define a consistent read for recovery.
acceptance_evidence: IAM review and integration test under the actual role for existing PENDING and PUBLISHED decisions.

finding_or_review_point: Encryption mode and complete cross-service resource policies are not specified.
risk: SSE-KMS may require missing key permissions; an allow for one producer is not proof that other same-account identities cannot send. Log writes need correct stream ARN scoping and an existing log group.
recommended_fix: Choose managed versus customer-managed encryption per service; document required KMS grants where applicable. Define producer identity policy, settlement queue SNS service-principal policy with source conditions, ops topic CloudWatch policy and precreated log group with correct stream ARN scope. Prove the desired exclusive-producer restriction.
acceptance_evidence: SAM/IAM review plus authorized/unauthorized send tests, encrypted SNS delivery test, first-invocation log write and alarm delivery test.

finding_or_review_point: No passenger-identifying data is too strong a claim for pnr and ticket_number.
risk: These identifiers can link to passenger records; unrestricted retention or access remains a privacy risk even without names.
recommended_fix: Classify the identifiers as sensitive/linkable; approve access, log minimization and retention for queues, DLQs, logs, decisions and backups. Distinguish retained financial evidence from expiring delivery metadata.
acceptance_evidence: Data-owner sign-off on classification, least-privilege access and deletion/retention policy.

finding_or_review_point: Unhandled unexpected exceptions can emit raw exception text and non-contract runtime error output.
risk: The stated no-raw-exception policy and explicit classified failure logging are not guaranteed by allowing the invocation to fail.
recommended_fix: Enumerate expected parser, Decimal and SDK failures and log safe ERROR classifications before FIFO partial failure responses. Agree an explicit policy for unexpected faults with the maintainer; do not silently introduce a broad catch against repository rules. Document limits of runtime-generated exception redaction.
acceptance_evidence: Inject parser, SDK and unexpected faults containing synthetic sensitive text; inspect application and runtime logs and prove classified safe failures without sensitive text leakage.

finding_or_review_point: Partial-batch failures need not increment Lambda Errors and failed log delivery is not reliably detected by that alarm.
risk: Repeated DynamoDB/SNS/validation failures can return successful invocations while decisions stall; loss of application logs may hide metric-filter alarms too.
recommended_fix: Alarm on bounded error_type metrics as well as queue age, pending publication age and delivery DLQs; monitor settlement lag and notification delivery. Replace the assertion that lost log lines are visible via Errors with an explicit limitation and independent health checks.
acceptance_evidence: Return partial failures without throwing and prove an operational notification; simulate a stranded PENDING record and a blocked alarm destination.

finding_or_review_point: Correlation validation, SNS envelope handling and logging conformance remain unverified.
risk: An invalid correlation attribute can violate logging-contract.json; SNS raw versus wrapped delivery changes where settlement reads attributes. Alarm notifications do not carry per-event correlation automatically.
recommended_fix: Validate correlation format/length and define safe handling of malformed values; specify RawMessageDelivery and settlement extraction. Distinguish alarm-level context from event-level correlation. Keep Day-2 JSON logging; Powertools/EMF are deferred by LOGGING_CONTRACT section 5 rather than required now.
acceptance_evidence: Run python3 day2/scripts/check_logs.py <captured-log> and attach CONFORMANT; test absent/invalid correlation and both envelope expectations. Explain the template's Day-4 scoring-anchor mismatch for human scoring.

finding_or_review_point: Per-event full history reads grow with booking history and the daily GSI key can concentrate settlement traffic.
risk: Increasing read cost, memory and latency can breach the 30-second timeout; a busy settlement_date may become a hot logical key at higher scale.
recommended_fix: Use bounded per-ticket/per-pnr summaries with conditional versioning and retain immutable history separately; specify DynamoDB capacity mode and GSI projection. Measure the daily index before adding sharding and paginate settlement queries.
acceptance_evidence: Load test long-lived pnr histories and a concentrated settlement day; record consumed capacity, throttles, p95, peak memory and timeout margin.

finding_or_review_point: FIFO partial failures are correctly described but batch size, SDK retry budgets and latency measurement boundary are unspecified.
risk: Retries or a slow record can consume the full invocation; a hot pnr cannot scale beyond serial processing regardless of MaximumConcurrency 5.
recommended_fix: Retain stop-after-first-failure behavior; specify FIFO batch size up to 10, bounded SDK connect/read/retry budgets and time-aware stopping. Validate visibility against runtime settings and define p95 as ingress-to-decision or ingress-to-settlement. H2 uses the Lambda execution role and synchronous poller invocation, not a separate mapping role.
acceptance_evidence: Timeout mid-batch, throttle and hot-group tests; prove all failed/unprocessed message IDs are returned and report p95 at the approved boundary.

finding_or_review_point: Cost numbers are explicitly from memory and the request inventory is incomplete.
risk: The estimate omits settlement receive/delete and processing, retry amplification, history read growth, PITR/storage, potential KMS and per-dimension metric series. Lambda invocation count also depends on batching.
recommended_fix: Recalculate in us-east-1 with dated official prices and documented message size, batch size, capacity mode, retention, history depth and retry assumptions; include the added recovery/DLQ resources and distinguish requests from billable units.
acceptance_evidence: Attach a reproducible low/expected/peak estimate and measured cost per unique decision without counting duplicate attempts as new decisions.

finding_or_review_point: Design is not built or load-tested; current-handler mismatch is declared by the architecture but not independently inspected in this review.
risk: A design document cannot demonstrate implementation correctness, valid SAM policies or the stated performance guarantees.
recommended_fix: Implement only after business/security approval; validate SAM, add unit/integration/fault tests for this CSV and retain us-east-1, Python 3.12, resource prefixes, memory <=2048 MB and the whole-course 10-Lambda cap. Supply six-boundary answers for added recovery hops.
acceptance_evidence: Reviewed implementation diff, SAM validation, automated results, 10x test report and logging CONFORMANT evidence before release.
